words.enDefinition: an exam held in the middle of a term

examples.en: The midterm covers chapters one to five and counts for thirty percent of the grade.
examples.zh: 「期中考试」覆盖第一到第五章，占总成绩的百分之三十。

examples.en: I picked up my graded midterm today and scored higher than I expected.
examples.zh: 我今天拿到了批改完的「期中考试」卷子，分数比预期高。

words.enDefinition: the major exam held at the end of a course

examples.en: Our final exam is three hours long and covers everything from the whole term.
examples.zh: 我们的「期末考试」长达三小时，考查整学期的内容。

examples.en: The professor moved the final exam to the gym because of the repairs.
examples.zh: 因为场馆维修，教授把「期末考试」挪到了体育馆。

words.enDefinition: an exam where notes and textbooks may be consulted

examples.en: The statistics final is an open-book exam, but you still need real understanding.
examples.zh: 统计期末是「开卷考试」，但你还是得真正弄懂才行。

examples.en: In an open-book exam, knowing where facts live matters more than memorizing them.
examples.zh: 「开卷考试」里，知道资料在哪比死记硬背更重要。

words.enDefinition: an exam completed alone over several days off campus

examples.en: Our professor gave us a forty-eight-hour take-home exam over the weekend.
examples.zh: 教授给我们布置了一个周末进行、限时四十八小时的「带回家完成的考试」。

examples.en: Even for a take-home exam, working with classmates breaks the honor code.
examples.zh: 即使是「带回家完成的考试」，与同学合作也违反荣誉准则。

words.enDefinition: an exam where no notes or books are allowed

examples.en: The anatomy final is a closed-book exam, so start memorizing early.
examples.zh: 解剖学期末是「闭卷考试」，所以要尽早开始背记。

examples.en: Law exams here are closed-book exams with a short list of permitted statutes.
examples.zh: 这里的法律考试是「闭卷考试」，只允许带一小部分法条入场。

words.enDefinition: a final testing material from the entire course

examples.en: Review every unit from September because the cumulative final covers the whole course.
examples.zh: 「综合性期末考」覆盖整门课，九月以来的每个单元都要复习。

examples.en: I started reviewing for the cumulative final a month early.
examples.zh: 我提前一个月就开始复习「综合性期末考」的内容。

words.enDefinition: a full-length trial exam used for revision

examples.en: Do at least one timed practice exam before the real thing.
examples.zh: 正式考试前，至少做一套限时「模拟测试」。

examples.en: The department website posts a practice exam with worked solutions every year.
examples.zh: 系网站每年都会发布一份附详解的「模拟测试」。

words.enDefinition: an exam paper from an earlier year used for revision

examples.en: Working through past papers is the fastest way to spot recurring questions.
examples.zh: 刷「历年真题」是找出常考题的最快方法。

examples.en: The library keeps past papers for most modules in its online archive.
examples.zh: 图书馆的线上档案保存着大多数课程的「历年真题」。

words.enDefinition: a rehearsal exam run under real exam conditions

examples.en: Our department runs a December mock exam so everyone learns the format.
examples.zh: 系里十二月安排了一场「模拟考试」，让大家都熟悉题型。

examples.en: I scored badly on the mock exam, which pushed me to revise harder.
examples.zh: 「模拟考试」我考砸了，这反而促使我加倍复习。

words.enDefinition: an ideal sample answer examiners use for marking

examples.en: Read the model answer first, then compare it with your own response.
examples.zh: 先读「参考范文」，再和你自己写的答案对比。

examples.en: The tutor shared a model answer showing how to structure an essay question.
examples.zh: 辅导老师分享了一份「参考范文」，示范论述题该如何搭结构。

words.enDefinition: a summary listing what a course exam will cover

examples.en: The professor posted a study guide listing every topic on the final.
examples.zh: 教授上传了一份「复习指南」，列出了期末考的所有考点。

examples.en: Our class built a shared study guide so nobody missed a key concept.
examples.zh: 全班合写了一份共享「复习指南」，谁都不会漏掉重点概念。

collocations: a study guide for the final

words.enDefinition: a uniform exam scored the same way for everyone

examples.en: Many international students take a standardized test like the TOEFL before applying.
examples.zh: 许多留学生在申请前要考托福这类「标准化考试」。

examples.en: Your standardized test scores arrive at universities together with your application.
examples.zh: 你的「标准化考试」成绩会随申请材料一起寄给大学。

words.enDefinition: an exam required for admission to a program

examples.en: She spent a full year preparing for the medical school entrance exam.
examples.zh: 她花了一整年准备医学院的「入学考试」。

examples.en: Some graduate programs require an entrance exam alongside your transcripts.
examples.zh: 有些研究生项目除成绩单外还要求「入学考试」。

words.enDefinition: a graduate exam covering a student's whole field

examples.en: Doctoral students take their comprehensive exams after finishing all required courses.
examples.zh: 博士生在修完全部必修课后参加「综合考试」。

examples.en: He spent the summer reading for comprehensive exams in three subject areas.
examples.zh: 他整个暑假都在为三个领域的「综合考试」读书备考。

words.enDefinition: a gatekeeper exam for staying in a doctoral program

examples.en: Failing the qualifying exam twice usually means leaving the program.
examples.zh: 「资格考试」两次不过，通常就意味着要退出项目。

examples.en: Her qualifying exam is scheduled for October before a faculty panel.
examples.zh: 她的「资格考试」定在十月，由教师小组主考。

words.enDefinition: a hands-on test of skills rather than knowledge

examples.en: The nursing course ends with a practical exam in the skills lab.
examples.zh: 护理课程以技能实验室里的「实操考试」收尾。

examples.en: In the chemistry practical exam, you have ninety minutes for three experiments.
examples.zh: 化学「实操考试」要求九十分钟内完成三个实验。

words.enDefinition: an exam taken by speaking with an examiner

examples.en: The language oral exam lasts fifteen minutes with two examiners asking questions.
examples.zh: 语言「口试」十五分钟，由两位考官提问。

examples.en: I was nervous before the oral exam, but the examiner was friendly.
examples.zh: 「口试」前我特别紧张，好在考官很友善。

words.enDefinition: an exam answered in long written responses

examples.en: History courses here favor essay exams over multiple choice questions.
examples.zh: 这里的历史课偏爱「论述题考试」而不是选择题。

examples.en: In an essay exam, a clear thesis in the opening paragraph earns marks.
examples.zh: 「论述题考试」里，开头段论点清晰就能拿分。

words.enDefinition: an exam supervised in person or online by a proctor

examples.en: The online course requires a proctored exam at an approved test center.
examples.zh: 这门网课要求在指定考点参加「有监考的考试」。

examples.en: Your webcam stays on during the proctored exam so the proctor can see you.
examples.zh: 「有监考的考试」期间摄像头必须开着，监考员要能看到你。

words.enDefinition: a short timed test on the course website

examples.en: Each module ends with a ten-question online quiz due Sunday night.
examples.zh: 每个单元以十道题的「在线测验」收尾，周日晚上截止。

examples.en: The online quiz locks at midnight, so never leave it to the last minute.
examples.zh: 「在线测验」午夜就会锁定，千万别拖到最后一刻。

words.enDefinition: the official schedule of when each exam happens

examples.en: Check the exam timetable before booking flights home for the holidays.
examples.zh: 订假期回家的机票前，先查「考试时间表」。

examples.en: The exam timetable went live today, and my two hardest papers are back to back.
examples.zh: 「考试时间表」今天公布，我最难的两门考试背靠背连着。

words.enDefinition: the weeks at term's end reserved for exams

examples.en: The library stays open around the clock during exam period.
examples.zh: 「考试期间」图书馆全天开放。

examples.en: No assignments fall due during exam period, so we can focus on revision.
examples.zh: 「考试期间」没有作业截止，大家可以专心复习。

words.enDefinition: the last week of term packed with final exams

examples.en: Campus goes quiet during finals week as everyone camps out in the library.
examples.zh: 「期末考试周」校园格外安静，大家都驻扎在图书馆里。

examples.en: I have three finals in four days, so finals week will be brutal.
examples.zh: 四天里三门期末考，这个「期末考试周」注定难熬。

words.enDefinition: the week when most scheduled exams take place

examples.en: Exam week runs from December twelfth to the nineteenth this year.
examples.zh: 今年的「考试周」从十二月十二日持续到十九日。

examples.en: Cafeterias across campus extend their opening hours during exam week.
examples.zh: 「考试周」期间，全校食堂都延长了营业时间。

words.enDefinition: days before finals with no classes for review

examples.en: Reading period gives us four days to review before finals begin.
examples.zh: 「停课复习期」让我们在期末开考前有四天时间复习。

examples.en: Most professors refuse to set assignment deadlines during reading period.
examples.zh: 大多数教授不会在「停课复习期」安排作业截止。

words.enDefinition: a week reserved for studying before exams

examples.en: Revision week starts Monday, and tutors run drop-in review sessions.
examples.zh: 「复习周」周一开始，导师会开设随到随问的答疑。

examples.en: I mapped out every day of revision week so no course gets neglected.
examples.zh: 我把「复习周」的每一天都排好了计划，绝不偏废任何一门课。

collocations: make the most of revision week

words.enDefinition: officially signing up to sit an exam

examples.en: Exam registration closes on Friday, so confirm your exam seats today.
examples.zh: 「考试报名」周五截止，今天就去确认考试安排。

examples.en: You must complete exam registration for the certification test two months ahead.
examples.zh: 参加资格认证考试，必须提前两个月完成「考试报名」。

words.enDefinition: two of your exams scheduled at the same time

examples.en: Report any exam conflict to the registrar within a week of the timetable release.
examples.zh: 时间表公布后一周内，如有「考试冲突」要上报教务处。

examples.en: My exam conflict was fixed by moving one paper to the late session.
examples.zh: 我的「考试冲突」通过把一门考试调到晚场解决了。

words.enDefinition: an exam postponed because illness or misfortune affected you

examples.en: She was granted a deferred exam after surgery during finals week.
examples.zh: 期末周动完手术后，她获准参加「缓考」。

examples.en: Apply for a deferred exam through the student portal with medical evidence.
examples.zh: 通过学生门户附上医疗证明申请「缓考」。

words.enDefinition: a second sitting for students who missed the original

examples.en: He missed the final with the flu and took the makeup exam in January.
examples.zh: 他因流感错过期末考，一月参加了「补考」。

examples.en: Makeup exams are usually harder, so never skip the original without a reason.
examples.zh: 「补考」通常更难，没有正当理由千万别错过正式考试。

words.enDefinition: another chance to take an exam you failed

examples.en: An August resit gives failing students one last chance to pass the module.
examples.zh: 八月的「补考」给不及格的学生最后一次通过这门课的机会。

examples.en: If you fail the resit too, you may have to repeat the year.
examples.zh: 如果「补考」还没过，你可能就得重修一年。

words.enDefinition: adjusted assessment after illness affects your exam performance

examples.en: Apply for special consideration if food poisoning struck on exam day.
examples.zh: 考试当天食物中毒的话，可以申请「特殊情况照顾」。

examples.en: Special consideration cannot change your answers, but it may add marks or allow a resit.
examples.zh: 「特殊情况照顾」改不了你的答案，但可能加分或安排补考。

words.enDefinition: a large room where many students sit exams

examples.en: Five hundred students filled the exam hall for the economics final.
examples.zh: 五百名学生坐满了经济学期末考的「考试大厅」。

examples.en: Leave your bag at the front of the exam hall before finding your seat.
examples.zh: 进「考试大厅」先把包放在前排，再去找自己的座位。

words.enDefinition: the building and room where an exam is held

examples.en: The exam venue changed to the sports center, so check your email.
examples.zh: 「考试地点」换到了体育中心，记得查看邮件。

examples.en: Arrive at the exam venue thirty minutes early to find the right building.
examples.zh: 提前三十分钟到达「考试地点」，留时间找对教学楼。

words.enDefinition: the assigned seat printed for your exam

examples.en: Your seat number is printed at the top of the admission ticket.
examples.zh: 你的「座位号」印在准考证的顶端。

examples.en: Find your seat number on the list posted outside the exam hall.
examples.zh: 「座位号」可以在考场外张贴的名单上查到。

words.enDefinition: the entry pass required to sit an exam

examples.en: Bring your admission ticket and passport to the test center.
examples.zh: 去考点要带上「准考证」和护照。

examples.en: Download the admission ticket from the portal two days before the exam.
examples.zh: 考试前两天，从教务系统下载「准考证」。

words.enDefinition: a supervisor who watches students during an exam

examples.en: Raise your hand if you need extra paper and the invigilator will come over.
examples.zh: 需要加纸就举手，「监考员」会走过来。

examples.en: The invigilator wrote the start and finish times on the whiteboard.
examples.zh: 「监考员」把开始和结束时间写在了白板上。

words.enDefinition: the American word for an exam supervisor

examples.en: The proctor checked every student ID before handing out the papers.
examples.zh: 「监考人员」发卷前逐一核对了学生证件。

examples.en: If your calculator dies mid-exam, quietly signal the proctor for help.
examples.zh: 考试中途计算器没电，就悄悄示意「监考人员」求助。

words.enDefinition: the strict silence and rules enforced in exams

examples.en: We ran the mock under full exam conditions, phones off and silence throughout.
examples.zh: 模拟考完全按「考场规则」进行，全程静音、手机关机。

examples.en: Practice essays under exam conditions to get used to writing quickly by hand.
examples.zh: 按「考场规则」练写文章，习惯快速手写作答。

words.enDefinition: the form where multiple-choice answers are marked

examples.en: Fill in the circles on the answer sheet completely with a number two pencil.
examples.zh: 用2B铅笔把「答题卡」上的圆圈涂满。

examples.en: Make sure your name appears on both the question paper and the answer sheet.
examples.zh: 确保试卷和「答题卡」上都写有自己的名字。

words.enDefinition: the official booklet for writing exam responses

examples.en: Ask the invigilator for a second answer booklet if you run out of space.
examples.zh: 「答题册」写满了就举手找监考员再要一本。

examples.en: Number every question clearly in the answer booklet so the marker can follow.
examples.zh: 在「答题册」里给每道题标好题号，方便阅卷老师查看。

words.enDefinition: loose paper for rough working during an exam

examples.en: Do your calculations on the scratch paper, not in the question booklet.
examples.zh: 计算过程写在「草稿纸」上，别写在试卷册里。

examples.en: The proctor collected everyone's scratch paper along with the finished exams.
examples.zh: 收卷时，监考人员把大家的「草稿纸」一并收走了。

words.enDefinition: a small booklet for handwritten US essay exams

examples.en: Buy two blue books at the campus store before the history final.
examples.zh: 历史期末考前，先在校内商店买两本「蓝皮答题册」。

examples.en: The professor let us outline our answers on the blue book cover.
examples.zh: 教授允许我们先在「蓝皮答题册」封面上列提纲。

words.enDefinition: a page of formulas provided in math or science exams

examples.en: The formula sheet is attached to the front of the physics paper.
examples.zh: 「公式表」附在物理试卷的最前面。

examples.en: Learn how to use every line on the formula sheet before exam day.
examples.zh: 考试前要练熟「公式表」上每一条公式的用法。

words.enDefinition: a page of notes used openly or secretly in exams

examples.en: The professor allows one handwritten cheat sheet for the statistics final.
examples.zh: 教授允许统计期末带一张手写「小抄」。

examples.en: He was caught with a cheat sheet in his sleeve and failed the course.
examples.zh: 他被发现袖子里藏着「小抄」，这门课直接挂掉。

collocations: get caught with a cheat sheet

words.enDefinition: a machine-read bubble sheet used in US exams

examples.en: Use a number two pencil on the scantron form, never a pen.
examples.zh: 「机读答题卡」一定要用2B铅笔填涂，千万别用钢笔。

examples.en: He filled in the wrong student number on his scantron form.
examples.zh: 他在「机读答题卡」上涂错了学号。

words.enDefinition: the printed set of questions for one exam

examples.en: Do not open the exam paper until the invigilator tells you to start.
examples.zh: 监考员宣布开始之前，不要翻开「试卷」。

examples.en: This exam paper was much harder than the past papers we practiced.
examples.zh: 这次的「试卷」比我们练过的历年真题难多了。

words.enDefinition: a calculator with advanced functions allowed in exams

examples.en: Only a scientific calculator without graphing functions is allowed in this exam.
examples.zh: 这场考试只允许使用不带绘图功能的「科学计算器」。

examples.en: Bring spare batteries for your scientific calculator on exam day.
examples.zh: 考试当天记得给「科学计算器」带上备用电池。

words.enDefinition: questions offering several options with one correct answer

examples.en: The biology midterm has fifty questions, all in multiple choice format.
examples.zh: 生物期中考有五十道题，全部是「选择题」。

examples.en: Eliminate two wrong options first, because multiple choice rewards strategy too.
examples.zh: 先排除两个错误选项，「选择题」也很讲策略。

words.enDefinition: brief written replies of a few sentences

examples.en: Section B has six short answer questions worth five points each.
examples.zh: B部分有六道「简答题」，每题五分。

examples.en: For short answer questions, give the definition plus one clear example.
examples.zh: 答「简答题」时，给出定义再加一个清晰的例子。

words.enDefinition: a statement you mark as true or false

examples.en: Ten true-false questions open the quiz, so read each statement carefully.
examples.zh: 测验开头是十道「判断题」，每句都要仔细读。

examples.en: Watch for words like always and never in true-false questions.
examples.zh: 做「判断题」时，要警惕 always 和 never 这类绝对词。

words.enDefinition: items asking you to complete missing words

examples.en: The vocabulary section is ten fill in the blank items from chapter four.
examples.zh: 词汇部分是十道出自第四章的「填空题」。

examples.en: For fill in the blank, check whether they want the infinitive or the conjugated form.
examples.zh: 做「填空题」要看清要求，该填动词原形还是变位形式。

collocations: a fill in the blank item
complete the fill in the blank

words.enDefinition: an item pairing terms from two columns

examples.en: The matching question asks you to pair fifteen authors with their works.
examples.zh: 这道「匹配题」要求把十五位作者与作品一一配对。

examples.en: Save the matching question for last, because leftover options help you eliminate pairs.
examples.zh: 「匹配题」留到最后做，剩下的选项能帮你排除错配。

words.enDefinition: a math question wrapped in a real-life story

examples.en: The exam had four word problems about interest rates and loan payments.
examples.zh: 考试里有四道关于利率和还贷的「应用题」。

examples.en: Underline the numbers first, because word problems hide the real question in the story.
examples.zh: 先把数字划出来，「应用题」会把真正的问题藏在情节里。

words.enDefinition: a second attempt at an exam you chose to redo

examples.en: She signed up for a retake of the standardized test in March.
examples.zh: 她报名三月「重考」那项标准化考试。

examples.en: Universities limit how many times you can retake an exam.
examples.zh: 大学对「重考」次数设有上限。

words.enDefinition: an extra question offering optional additional points

examples.en: There is a bonus question at the end worth five extra points.
examples.zh: 卷末有一道「附加题」，值五分附加分。

examples.en: Attempt the bonus question even if unsure, because it can only help your score.
examples.zh: 「附加题」没把握也要试一试，它只会拉高你的分数。

collocations: a bonus question at the end

words.enDefinition: a question designed to mislead careless readers

examples.en: The last item was a trick question with two nearly identical options.
examples.zh: 最后一题是道「陷阱题」，两个选项几乎一模一样。

examples.en: Read every word twice, because trick questions love absolute words like always.
examples.zh: 每个词都要读两遍，「陷阱题」最爱用 always 这类绝对词。

words.enDefinition: to attend and attempt a formal exam

examples.en: You will sit the exam in the main hall with around three hundred others.
examples.zh: 你将在主考场「应考」，同场大约还有三百人。

examples.en: Students who sit the exam in August receive their results in September.
examples.zh: 八月「应考」的学生九月拿到成绩。

words.enDefinition: to attempt an official test or exam

examples.en: You can take the exam in December or wait and take it in May.
examples.zh: 你可以十二月「参加考试」，也可以等到五月再考。

examples.en: International students take the exam on campus with their passports as identification.
examples.zh: 留学生「参加考试」时用护照核验身份。

words.enDefinition: to have points deducted for errors or omissions

examples.en: You lose marks if you skip units in physics calculations.
examples.zh: 物理计算里漏写单位会「被扣分」。

examples.en: Many students lose marks by spelling key terms incorrectly, so double-check terminology.
examples.zh: 很多学生因为关键术语拼写错误「被扣分」，一定要反复核对。

words.enDefinition: every point available on a question or paper

examples.en: She got full marks on the multiple choice section again.
examples.zh: 她在选择题部分又一次拿了「满分」。

examples.en: Full marks on this essay are rare, since the average sits around sixty percent.
examples.zh: 这篇论述很少有人拿「满分」，平均分通常在百分之六十上下。

words.enDefinition: a result with no points lost anywhere

examples.en: He achieved a perfect score on the quantitative section again this year.
examples.zh: 他今年又在数学部分拿到了「满分」。

examples.en: A perfect score does not guarantee admission, but it certainly helps.
examples.zh: 「满分」不能保证录取，但肯定有帮助。

collocations: a perfect score on the section

words.enDefinition: ruling out wrong options to reach the answer

examples.en: Use the process of elimination when you are stuck between two choices.
examples.zh: 在两个选项之间拿不定主意时，就用「排除法」。

examples.en: The process of elimination got me the answer even without remembering the rule.
examples.zh: 即使记不清规则，靠「排除法」我也推出了答案。

words.enDefinition: to reduce many options to a likely few

examples.en: Narrow down the four options to two before you guess.
examples.zh: 猜答案之前，先把四个选项「缩小范围」到两个。

examples.en: Crossing out obviously wrong answers helps you narrow down your choices quickly.
examples.zh: 划掉明显错误的选项，能帮你快速「缩小范围」。

words.enDefinition: to spread your effort evenly across the exam

examples.en: Pace yourself so the final essay gets its fair share of time.
examples.zh: 要「合理分配时间」，让最后一篇论述分到足够的时间。

examples.en: Glance at the clock every twenty minutes and pace yourself across the sections.
examples.zh: 每二十分钟看一眼表，跨部分「合理分配时间」。

words.enDefinition: to pass an exam with an excellent result

examples.en: Review the past papers thoroughly and you may pass with flying colors.
examples.zh: 把历年真题刷透，你就能「以高分通过」。

examples.en: He passed with flying colors despite missing two weeks of lectures.
examples.zh: 虽然缺了两周的课，他还是「以高分通过」。

collocations: pass the exam with flying colors
with flying colors on the first attempt

words.enDefinition: to get a top result on an exam

examples.en: Read the summaries twice and you will ace the exam.
examples.zh: 把总结读两遍，你就能在考试中「考出高分」。

examples.en: After rewriting all the reaction mechanisms, he managed to ace the exam.
examples.zh: 重写完所有反应机理之后，他终于在考试中「考出高分」。

words.enDefinition: to score below the required pass level

examples.en: If you fail an exam, you can usually resit it in August.
examples.zh: 如果「考试不及格」，通常八月可以补考。

examples.en: He was crushed to fail an exam for the first time in his life.
examples.zh: 人生第一次「考试不及格」，他整个人都懵了。

collocations: fail an exam by two points

words.enDefinition: to fail an exam, especially badly

examples.en: Anyone can flunk an exam they never really prepared for.
examples.zh: 从没认真准备过的人，考试不「考砸」才怪。

examples.en: She was shocked to flunk an exam after acing every quiz.
examples.zh: 每次小测都拿高分，却在正式考试里「考砸」，她非常意外。

words.enDefinition: to reread responses before handing the paper in

examples.en: Save ten minutes to review your answers before the invigilator calls time.
examples.zh: 留出十分钟「检查答案」，再等监考员宣布收卷。

examples.en: Review your answers at least once, since transferred digits are the most common slip.
examples.zh: 至少「检查答案」一遍，誊写错数字是最常见的失误。

collocations: time left to review your answers

words.enDefinition: to skip a question without writing anything

examples.en: Never leave a question blank, because a reasonable guess might earn points.
examples.zh: 千万别「空着不答」，合理的猜测也可能得分。

examples.en: It is better to guess than to leave a question blank in multiple choice.
examples.zh: 做选择题，宁可猜一个也不要「空着不答」。

words.enDefinition: to mark an online question to revisit later

examples.en: Flag a question and come back to it after finishing the section.
examples.zh: 先「标记题目」，等做完这一部分再回头处理。

examples.en: Flag a question whenever you stall, and clear all flags before submitting.
examples.zh: 卡壳时就「标记题目」，提交前再把所有标记清掉。

words.enDefinition: to solve a problem starting from the result

examples.en: For the discount problem, work backwards from the final price.
examples.zh: 做打折那道题时，从最终价格「倒推解题」。

examples.en: Working backwards helped her spot exactly where the equation went wrong.
examples.zh: 「倒推解题」帮她准确找到了方程出错的地方。

words.enDefinition: a formal panel meeting over suspected academic dishonesty

examples.en: He was called to an academic integrity hearing after two identical essays were submitted.
examples.zh: 两篇论文雷同之后，他被叫去参加「学术诚信听证会」。

examples.en: At the academic integrity hearing, she explained that the quoted paragraph was missing citation marks.
examples.zh: 在「学术诚信听证会」上，她解释说那段引文漏了引注符号。

words.enDefinition: cheating, copying, or breaking assessment rules

examples.en: Sharing your take-home answers with a friend counts as academic misconduct.
examples.zh: 把带回家考试的答案分享给朋友，属于「学术不端」。

examples.en: The syllabus lists every form of academic misconduct, including unauthorized collaboration.
examples.zh: 课程大纲列出了所有「学术不端」形式，包括未经允许的合作。

words.enDefinition: a student pledge not to cheat in assessments

examples.en: Every exam paper opens with the honor code, which you sign.
examples.zh: 每份试卷开头都是需要签名的「荣誉准则」。

examples.en: Under the honor code, students are expected to report cheating they witness.
examples.zh: 根据「荣誉准则」，学生看到作弊行为应当举报。

words.enDefinition: notes or devices not permitted in an exam room

examples.en: Having unauthorized materials on your desk, even a phone, triggers an incident report.
examples.zh: 桌面上出现「违禁材料」，哪怕是手机，都会被记录上报。

examples.en: The invigilator confiscated the unauthorized materials and noted the incident.
examples.zh: 监考员没收了「违禁材料」，并记录了这次违规。

collocations: unauthorized materials in the exam room

words.enDefinition: punishment imposed after serious rule breaking

examples.en: Copying on the final can lead to disciplinary action, including suspension.
examples.zh: 期末考试抄袭可能招致「纪律处分」，甚至停学。

examples.en: The committee decided no disciplinary action was needed once she explained the mix-up.
examples.zh: 她解释清楚误会之后，委员会决定不予「纪律处分」。

words.enDefinition: exam nerves strong enough to hurt performance

examples.en: Deep breathing before the paper helps many students manage test anxiety.
examples.zh: 发卷前的深呼吸能帮很多学生缓解「考试焦虑」。

examples.en: Her test anxiety eased noticeably after several timed practice exams.
examples.zh: 做了几次限时模拟测试后，她的「考试焦虑」明显减轻了。

words.enDefinition: a sudden freeze in thinking under pressure

examples.en: I hit a mental block on question three and wasted ten minutes.
examples.zh: 第三题我「思维卡壳」，白白浪费了十分钟。

examples.en: Move on when a mental block hits, then return with fresh eyes.
examples.zh: 「思维卡壳」时先跳过去，回头再看思路自然就顺了。

collocations: a mental block in the exam

words.enDefinition: to do your best work when the stakes are high

examples.en: Timed practice teaches you to perform under pressure on exam day.
examples.zh: 限时练习让你学会在考试当天「在压力下发挥」。

examples.en: Some students genuinely perform under pressure, while others need calm to think.
examples.zh: 有些学生确实能「在压力下发挥」，另一些则需要平静才能思考。

collocations: train yourself to perform under pressure

words.enDefinition: a planned method for attacking exam questions

examples.en: A simple test-taking strategy is answering the easy questions first.
examples.zh: 一个简单的「应试策略」是先做容易的题。

examples.en: The learning center runs workshops on test-taking strategies before finals.
examples.zh: 学习中心在期末前开设「应试策略」工作坊。

words.enDefinition: a formal challenge to an assigned course grade

examples.en: File a grade appeal within ten working days of the results release.
examples.zh: 成绩公布后十个工作日内提交「成绩申诉」。

examples.en: Her grade appeal succeeded after the department found a totaling error.
examples.zh: 系里查出总分算错后，她的「成绩申诉」成功了。

words.enDefinition: a request for an exam to be marked again

examples.en: Submit a regrade request if you believe the rubric was misapplied.
examples.zh: 如果你认为评分标准用错了，可以提交「重新判分申请」。

examples.en: The regrade request window closes one week after grades are posted.
examples.zh: 「重新判分申请」的窗口在成绩发布一周后关闭。

words.enDefinition: a marking mistake in totaling or applying the rubric

examples.en: A grading error added my points twice on question six.
examples.zh: 第六题出了「评分错误」，我的分数被加了两遍。

examples.en: Compare your scanned paper with the posted scores before claiming a grading error.
examples.zh: 主张存在「评分错误」之前，先把自己的试卷扫描件和公布分数核对一遍。

collocations: a grading error on question six

words.enDefinition: the cutoff score separating two letter grades

examples.en: The grade boundary for an A landed at ninety-two this year.
examples.zh: 今年A等的「等级分数线」定在了九十二分。

examples.en: Because the exam was hard, the grade boundary shifted down two points.
examples.zh: 这次考试偏难，「等级分数线」下调了两分。

collocations: the grade boundary for an A

words.enDefinition: the minimum score needed to pass an exam

examples.en: The pass mark for the licensing exam is seventy percent.
examples.zh: 执照考试的「及格线」是百分之七十。

examples.en: You need every quiz point to stay comfortably above the pass mark.
examples.zh: 想稳稳站在「及格线」之上，每次小测的分数都不能丢。

collocations: the pass mark is seventy percent

words.enDefinition: the percentage of candidates who pass an exam

examples.en: Only forty percent of first-timers pass, so the pass rate is famously low.
examples.zh: 首考通过的人只有四成，这个「通过率」出了名的低。

examples.en: The department celebrated when the module's pass rate climbed to eighty percent.
examples.zh: 这门课的「通过率」升到百分之八十时，全系都开了庆祝会。

collocations: the pass rate for first-time candidates

words.enDefinition: points earned before any scaling or conversion

examples.en: Your raw score is simply the number of questions you answered correctly.
examples.zh: 「原始分」就是你答对题目的数量。

examples.en: The conversion table turns each raw score into a scaled score.
examples.zh: 换算表会把每个「原始分」折算成标准分。

collocations: raw score out of one hundred

words.enDefinition: a raw score adjusted onto a uniform scale

examples.en: The scaled score smooths out small differences between exam versions.
examples.zh: 「折算分」会抹平各试卷版本之间的细微难度差异。

examples.en: A raw score of forty-two became a scaled score of one hundred and twenty.
examples.zh: 四十二分的原始分折算后是一百二十分的「折算分」。

words.enDefinition: the normal distribution shape used to adjust grades

examples.en: The professor fits results to a bell curve so the average lands midrange.
examples.zh: 教授按「钟形曲线」调分，让平均分落在中间段。

examples.en: On a strict bell curve, your grade also depends on how classmates performed.
examples.zh: 在严格的「钟形曲线」下，你的成绩还要看同学们的表现。

collocations: fit results to a bell curve

words.enDefinition: to set grades relative to class performance

examples.en: The professor will grade on a curve, so only the top fifteen percent get an A.
examples.zh: 教授会「按曲线调分」，只有前百分之十五能拿A。

examples.en: If everyone does badly, grading on a curve can actually raise your grade.
examples.zh: 如果大家都考得差，「按曲线调分」反而可能抬高你的成绩。

collocations: grade the midterm on a curve
decide to grade on a curve

words.enDefinition: the mean exam score across the whole class

examples.en: The class average on the midterm came out at sixty-eight percent.
examples.zh: 这次期中的「班级平均分」是百分之六十八。

examples.en: Scores here are judged against the class average, not a fixed scale.
examples.zh: 这里的成绩参照「班级平均分」评定，而不是固定标准。

collocations: ten points above the class average

words.enDefinition: the spread of grades across a whole class

examples.en: The grade distribution showed a tight cluster in the B range.
examples.zh: 「成绩分布」显示大家密集集中在B档。

examples.en: Check the grade distribution before assuming the exam was unfair.
examples.zh: 先看看「成绩分布」，再下结论说考试不公。

words.enDefinition: the chart converting percentages into letter grades

examples.en: On this grading scale, ninety-three is the cutoff for an A.
examples.zh: 按这张「评分等级表」，九十三分是A等的门槛。

examples.en: The syllabus includes the grading scale plus the weight of each assessment.
examples.zh: 课程大纲附有「评分等级表」以及各项考核的权重。

words.enDefinition: a course result expressed as a letter

examples.en: Your letter grade combines the midterm, the final, and the homework.
examples.zh: 你的「等级成绩」由期中、期末和作业综合而成。

examples.en: She needs a B or better, since the program requires that letter grade.
examples.zh: 项目要求「等级成绩」达到B或以上，她必须考到这个水平。

words.enDefinition: the overall course result from all assessments

examples.en: Your final grade posts to the portal two days after the exam.
examples.zh: 考试结束两天后，「最终成绩」会发布到教务系统。

examples.en: The final grade weights the exam at sixty percent of the total.
examples.zh: 「最终成绩」里考试占总分的百分之六十。

words.enDefinition: the grade reported after midterm exams

examples.en: My midterm grade was a B minus, so the final matters even more.
examples.zh: 我的「期中成绩」是B减，期末就更关键了。

examples.en: The portal posts midterm grades two weeks before the withdrawal deadline.
examples.zh: 教务系统会在退课截止前两周公布「期中成绩」。

words.enDefinition: the official document listing standardized test results

examples.en: Order an extra score report for each university on your list.
examples.zh: 给你申请名单上的每所大学都订一份额外的「成绩报告」。

examples.en: The official score report breaks down your performance by section.
examples.zh: 官方「成绩报告」会分部分列出你的表现。

words.enDefinition: the share each assessment counts toward results

examples.en: The grade weighting gives the final exam fifty percent of the total.
examples.zh: 按「成绩权重」，期末考占总分的一半。

examples.en: Check the grade weighting before deciding which midterm to prioritize.
examples.zh: 决定先抓哪门期中之前，先看清「成绩权重」。

words.enDefinition: a temporary grade for unfinished course requirements

examples.en: She received an incomplete grade after missing the final for surgery.
examples.zh: 因手术错过期末考后，她拿到了「未完成成绩」。

examples.en: An incomplete grade must be cleared within one semester or it becomes an F.
examples.zh: 「未完成成绩」必须在一学期内补清，否则自动记为F。

words.enDefinition: the ID number you write on exam papers

examples.en: Write your candidate number on every page of the answer booklet.
examples.zh: 答题册的每一页都要写上你的「考生号」。

examples.en: Your candidate number keeps your exam anonymous throughout the marking process.
examples.zh: 「考生号」能让你的试卷在整个阅卷过程中保持匿名。

words.enDefinition: the official day exam results are released

examples.en: On results day, the portal crashes every year at nine sharp.
examples.zh: 每年「放榜日」九点整，教务系统都会被挤爆。

examples.en: She barely slept the night before results day, refreshing the portal constantly.
examples.zh: 「放榜日」前夜她几乎没睡，一直刷新教务页面。

words.enDefinition: your rank against other test takers in percent

examples.en: A ninetieth-percentile score means you beat ninety percent of test takers.
examples.zh: 第九十「百分位数」意味着你超过了百分之九十的考生。

examples.en: Admissions teams look at your percentile, not just your raw score.
examples.zh: 招生团队看的是你的「百分位数」，而不只是原始分。

words.enDefinition: low-stakes checks that guide ongoing learning

examples.en: Weekly quizzes are formative assessment, so mistakes there cost almost nothing.
examples.zh: 每周小测属于「形成性评估」，出错几乎不扣分。

examples.en: Good formative assessment shows what to fix before the final exam.
examples.zh: 好的「形成性评估」能让你在期末考前发现该补的漏洞。

words.enDefinition: a final evaluation that determines the course grade

examples.en: The final project is the course's only real summative assessment.
examples.zh: 期末项目是这门课唯一真正的「终结性评估」。

examples.en: Unlike quizzes, summative assessments cannot be retaken just for practice.
examples.zh: 和小测不同，「终结性评估」不能为了练手而重考。

words.enDefinition: grades built up through coursework during the term

examples.en: Under continuous assessment, every lab report counts toward your final mark.
examples.zh: 在「平时考核」制度下，每份实验报告都计入期末总评。

examples.en: Continuous assessment suits steady workers better than one big final does.
examples.zh: 相比一锤子买卖的期末大考，「平时考核」更适合稳扎稳打的人。

words.enDefinition: the preparation work done before an exam

examples.en: The tutoring center offers free exam prep sessions for calculus.
examples.zh: 辅导中心为微积分考试提供免费的「考前准备」课程。

examples.en: Good exam prep starts with the syllabus, not with the textbook.
examples.zh: 有效的「考前准备」要从课程大纲入手，而不是抱着课本硬啃。

words.enDefinition: a plan dividing revision time across subjects

examples.en: Print a revision timetable and pin it above your desk.
examples.zh: 打印一张「复习计划表」，贴在书桌上方。

examples.en: My revision timetable gives the hardest course the first hour every morning.
examples.zh: 我的「复习计划表」把每天第一个小时留给最难的那门课。

words.enDefinition: condensed notes made for final review

examples.en: Condense each lecture into a single page of revision notes.
examples.zh: 把每节课浓缩成一页「复习笔记」。

examples.en: We swapped revision notes to cover the lectures each of us missed.
examples.zh: 我们互换「复习笔记」，补上彼此缺掉的那几节课。

words.enDefinition: drill questions done while preparing for exams

examples.en: Work through the practice questions at the end of each chapter.
examples.zh: 把每章末尾的「练习题」都过一遍。

examples.en: The tutor emailed us fifty practice questions styled like the real exam.
examples.zh: 辅导老师发来了五十道仿照真题风格的「练习题」。

collocations: practice questions at the end of the chapter

words.enDefinition: a large pool of questions for practice or exams

examples.en: The instructor draws the weekly quizzes from a rotating question bank.
examples.zh: 老师每周的小测都从一个轮换的「题库」里抽题。

examples.en: Buy access to the online question bank for extra drilling.
examples.zh: 可以购买在线「题库」权限，多刷一些题。

collocations: a question bank of past items

words.enDefinition: an exam run against a strict countdown

examples.en: The timed exam closes automatically once the countdown hits zero.
examples.zh: 倒计时一归零，「限时考试」就会自动关闭。

examples.en: Practice under a timed exam setting before the real online test.
examples.zh: 正式在线测试前，先按「限时考试」模式练一遍。

words.enDefinition: an exam taken on a computer at a center

examples.en: The language certificate switched to a computer-based test last year.
examples.zh: 这项语言证书去年改成了「机考」。

examples.en: You still get scratch paper even in the computer-based test.
examples.zh: 即使是「机考」，也会发草稿纸。

words.enDefinition: an approved site where standardized exams are run

examples.en: Book a test center seat early, because weekend slots fill fast.
examples.zh: 尽早预订「考点」考位，周末的名额很快就满了。

examples.en: Arrive at the test center an hour early with your identification.
examples.zh: 提前一小时带好证件到「考点」。

words.enDefinition: online exam supervision through webcam software

examples.en: Remote proctoring flags suspicious eye movements during the online exam.
examples.zh: 「远程监考」会标记在线考试中可疑的视线移动。

examples.en: Test the remote proctoring software a day early to fix browser issues.
examples.zh: 提前一天测试「远程监考」软件，免得浏览器出岔子。

words.enDefinition: to fail to attend a scheduled exam

examples.en: If you miss an exam for illness, apply for a deferred sitting immediately.
examples.zh: 如果因病「错过考试」，要立刻申请缓考。

examples.en: Oversleeping is not an accepted excuse when you miss an exam.
examples.zh: 因为睡过头而「错过考试」，可不是能被批准的理由。

collocations: miss an exam due to illness
miss an exam without a valid excuse

words.enDefinition: a supervised toilet visit allowed during an exam

examples.en: Raise your hand for a bathroom break and an invigilator will escort you.
examples.zh: 想「上洗手间」就举手，监考员会带你去。

examples.en: No bathroom break is allowed in the first half hour of the exam.
examples.zh: 开考后的半小时内不允许「上洗手间」。

collocations: no bathroom break in the first hour

words.enDefinition: written clearly enough to be read easily

examples.en: Graders cannot award marks they cannot read, so keep your writing legible.
examples.zh: 阅卷老师看不清就给不了分，字迹一定要「工整清晰」。

examples.en: If your handwriting is not legible, the grader may skip your correct steps.
examples.zh: 如果字迹不「工整清晰」，阅卷老师可能直接跳过你写对的步骤。

words.enDefinition: an error in how a word is spelled

examples.en: Minor spelling mistakes rarely cost points here unless they change the meaning.
examples.zh: 在这里，小的「拼写错误」一般不扣分，除非改变了词义。

examples.en: The examiner circled every spelling mistake on my essay in red pen.
examples.zh: 考官用红笔圈出了我文章里的每一处「拼写错误」。

words.enDefinition: an avoidable error caused by rushing or inattention

examples.en: Careless mistakes in the sign of the operation cost me six points.
examples.zh: 运算符号上的「粗心失误」让我丢了六分。

examples.en: Reread the last line of every calculation to catch careless mistakes.
examples.zh: 每步计算的末行都重读一遍，抓出「粗心失误」。

words.enDefinition: the skill of answering exams for maximum marks

examples.en: Good exam technique means answering the easiest questions first to bank marks early.
examples.zh: 好的「作答技巧」是先做最容易的题，尽早把分拿到手。

examples.en: Her exam technique improved a lot after the learning center workshop.
examples.zh: 上完学习中心的工作坊后，她的「作答技巧」进步了很多。

words.enDefinition: to fill the circles on a machine-read answer sheet

examples.en: Bubble in your answers completely, or the scanner will miss them.
examples.zh: 「涂答题卡」时要涂满涂黑，否则扫描仪会漏读。

examples.en: Remember to bubble in your student number before the timer starts.
examples.zh: 计时开始前，记得先「涂答题卡」填好学号。

words.enDefinition: the organization that sets and marks external exams

examples.en: Our final qualifications are issued by the Cambridge exam board.
examples.zh: 我们的最终学历证书由剑桥「考试委员会」颁发。

examples.en: The exam board publishes the grade boundaries every August online.
examples.zh: 「考试委员会」每年八月都会在线公布等级分数线。

words.enDefinition: the charge for registering to sit an exam

examples.en: The exam fee for the standardized test went up this year.
examples.zh: 这项标准化考试的「考试费」今年涨价了。

examples.en: Some departments refund the exam fee if you withdraw before the deadline.
examples.zh: 如果在截止日期前退考，有些院系会退还「考试费」。
